sql: WITH s AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.id,d.body,stannum.full_score(d.ctid) score FROM shape_documents d WHERE body ==> 'wordaa OR wordab OR wordac OR wordad OR wordae OR wordaf OR wordag OR wordah OR wordai OR wordaj OR wordak OR wordal OR wordam OR wordan OR wordao OR wordap OR wordaq OR wordar OR wordas OR wordat OR wordau OR wordav OR wordaw OR wordax OR worday OR wordaz OR wordba OR wordbb OR wordbc OR wordbd OR wordbe OR wordbf') SELECT json_build_object('rows',count(*),'bodies',md5(string_agg(id::text || body,',' ORDER BY id)),'scores',md5(string_agg(id::text || encode(float4send(score),'hex'),',' ORDER BY id))) FROM s
protocol: Create 1024-document query_shapes fixture in baseline image.
Session A: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ; execute sql.
Session B: UPDATE shape_documents SET body='wordaa '||body WHERE id%3=0; commit.
Session A: execute identical sql, then ROLLBACK.
With no writes running, validate exact top-10 score multisets and membership for OR2/32/128.
